The [[Ocean Museum Germany]] concludes that Timmy likely died shortly after being released from the [[barge]] due to exhaustion. '''Politics and elections'''
*[[Constitutional crisis in Somalia]]
**[[Controversies of Hassan Sheikh Mohamud]]
***International representatives, excluding those from the [[United Kingdom]] and the [[United States]], meet in [[Mogadishu]] and deem the [[Presidency of Hassan Sheikh Mohamud|administration of Hassan Sheikh Mohamud]] as the ''[[de facto]]'' [[Somalia|Somali]] government. Operational Policy 7.30, a framework typically applied to countries that have lost statehood or where a government assumes power outside the country’s constitutional framework, will be utilized.
